@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 9b80
+title: 'EXTRAS: MLXModelLoader takes a Hugging Face token provider'
+---
+## Goal
+A host with its own home (the Mac app, a CLI with `--home`) gives the Hugging Face token to the model loader. Today `MLXModelLoader.hubClient()` builds `HubClient(cache:)`, whose default token provider is `.environment`: it reads `HF_TOKEN` and `~/.cache/huggingface/token`, whatever folder the host chose. Requested by ACPAgent (AgentHome, f7f9932).
+
+## What
+- `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsExtras/Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/ModelPool/MLXModelLoader.swift`: `public init(cacheDirectory: URL? = nil, tokenProvider: TokenProvider = .environment, tokenizerLoader: (any TokenizerLoader)? = nil)`. `TokenProvider` is swift-huggingface's type (`.fixed`, `.custom`, `.none`, ...). Store it; `hubClient()` passes it to the `HubClient` init that takes a token provider and the cache.
+- Doc comment: the default `.environment` reads `HF_TOKEN` and `~/.cache/huggingface/token`; a host with its own home passes `.custom { ... }` reading its own token file, or `.none`.
+
+## Subtasks
+- [ ] Failing test first: a loader made with `.fixed(token: "t")` gives a hub client whose token provider yields "t"; `.none` yields nil.
+- [ ] Add the parameter and pass it through `hubClient()`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The token a download uses comes from the given provider, not from `~/.cache/huggingface/token`, when the host gives one.
+- [ ] The default stays `.environment`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `swift test` in FoundationModelsExtras passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. #extras #hosting
\ No newline at end of file
